news.title: Calling All Presidents: Attend Exclusive Events at ACEx2027
news.summary_en: Three events exclusively for college and university presidents and chancellors are on tap during the ACE Experience 2027 (ACEx2027).

news.title: Higher Education Groups Oppose Trump Administration Proposed Rule to Remove “Deference” Policy
news.summary_en: ACE, others are asking DHS to withdraw its proposed rule ending the policy of deferring to earlier visa approvals in making decisions about H-1B extension requests.
